messages:
Nadia H.: Planning: routing SLO experiment + controlled spill test on Sun 2026-07-12 01:30-03:30 UTC. Goal: validate smart-routing decisions when per-route SLOs diverge and ensure graceful spill to regional fallbacks. Affects Dedicated pools in ap-southeast-1 and us-east-2. Hosted public pools unaffected.

Ibrahim T.: High level: how many waves and expected traffic %? Any customer exclusions?

Nadia H.: We'll do 4 tiny waves (01:30, 02:00, 02:30, 03:00 UTC). Each wave will route ~3% traffic through a modified router decision that prefers lower-cost nodes even if p99 slightly higher. Enterprise orgs on the critical list are excluded.

CliBot: Maintenance ticket created: https://internal/maintenance/2380012345 state: scheduled owner: @Nadia H. notify: oncall slack_channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Jess: I'll be on-call. Prechecks I'll run 45m prior: replica lag < 200ms, routing table convergence < 20s, agent health = green.

Ibrahim T.: Rollback conditions? We should auto-revert if any paid route breaches SLO.

Nadia H.: Rollback rules: auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.4% for 2m OR p99 > 2s for 3m on paid routes. For bulk routes threshold is p99 > 3s. Also enable 3% TRACE sampling if p99 > 1s.

Oncall Jess: I'll enable temporary alert mute for the test routes and post one-line statuses during observe windows: wave1 started / wave1 OK / wave2 started / wave2 rollback (if any) / finished.

Ibrahim T.: We'll run a small synthetic client during each wave: ./synth --region ap-southeast-1 --qps 80 --routes file://tests/routing-slo.json

Nadia H.: Please DM me any org-ids that need exclusion. After the run we'll publish a short post-mortem and update the routing runbook with observed heuristics. Keep thread minimal in observe windows. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
